_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular manifest fragment — never edit src/manifest.json directly for a new feature; this file adds the routes ON TOP of the 5 cluster ids (Bookkeeping/Sales/Purchasing/BankingCashflow/Taxes) that this same change already defines/renames in src/manifest.json's own base menu — mirrors the pattern reporting-compliance.json already uses for the pre-existing Compliance/ReportingCompliance group.
_meta.description: ADR-097 Decision-4 landing pages for the 5 clusters that don't already have one (Reporting & Compliance reuses the pre-existing ReportingComplianceOverview as-is, design.md §3). Each cluster's top-level menu[].route is set HERE (not in src/manifest.json) for the same reason reporting-compliance.json's own _menu_note gives: main.js mergeMenuItems only fills a base group's MISSING 'route' field from a fragment, and the base-manifest consistency validator only resolves routes against base-declared pages — these landing pages are fragment-declared. `type: 'custom'`, one Vue component each under src/components/<cluster-slug>/, all thin wrappers around the shared src/components/cluster-overview/ClusterOverview.vue card grid (design.md §3).
